rows: the daytime scoring hours of the window with AC truth (§14.1), op-limited hours included; never fit rows
explainer: shap.TreeExplainer, feature_perturbation='tree_path_dependent', no background; the booster sliced to n_rounds = best iteration + 1
output: the booster's raw output in the training unit (k or kW); the kW view phi_kW = b * theo * phi_k for the indirect route (X47)
groups: selection.common.group, one group per feature by exact name (M27)

tolerances.why: TreeSHAP sums in float32: about 1e-6 of the output scale

non_causal: SHAP describes how the fitted booster maps its inputs to its output on these rows (tree-path-dependent masking); it is not a causal effect of a feature on the plant.
not_explained: BiLSTM and PatchTST (no attribution in v6; scope rule of §16b)
